standards.wstg: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide v4.2

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-01 Test Network Infrastructure Configuration - TLS and HTTP exposure
tests.wstg_section: Test Network Infrastructure Configuration
tests.expected_result: HTTPS responds successfully and cleartext HTTP either redirects to HTTPS or is not exposed.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-07 Test HTTP Strict Transport Security - browser header baseline
tests.wstg_section: Test HTTP Strict Transport Security; Testing for Clickjacking
tests.asvs_section: Browser Security and HTTP Response Headers
tests.expected_result: Responses include HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, CORP, and no-store where appropriate.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-12 Testing for Content Security Policy - OSMAP CSP regression
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Content Security Policy
tests.asvs_section: Browser Security and Content Security Policy
tests.expected_result: CSP is default-deny, disallows script execution, limits forms to self, and denies framing.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-ATHN-01 Testing for Credentials Transported over an Encrypted Channel - login form
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Credentials Transported over an Encrypted Channel; Testing for Weaker Authentication in Alternative Channel
tests.expected_result: Login form is HTTPS-served and contains username, password, and TOTP fields without exposing implementation details.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-IDNT-04 Testing for Account Enumeration and Guessable User Account - login failure normalization
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Account Enumeration and Guessable User Account; Testing for Weak Lock Out Mechanism
tests.expected_result: Invalid username and invalid password attempts produce generic failure behavior without user enumeration.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-ATHN-03 Testing for Weak Lock Out Mechanism - bounded login throttle probe
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Weak Lock Out Mechanism
tests.expected_result: A bounded invalid-login probe observes 401 responses or a throttled response without triggering uncontrolled lockout.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-ATHN-10 Testing for Weaker Authentication in Alternative Channel - TOTP login flow
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Weaker Authentication in Alternative Channel
tests.expected_result: Valid credentials plus current TOTP create an authenticated browser session.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-SESS-02 Testing for Cookies Attributes - OSMAP session cookie
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Cookies Attributes
tests.expected_result: The session cookie uses Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and Path=/.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-SESS-03 Testing for Session Fixation - pre-login cookie replacement
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Session Fixation
tests.expected_result: A caller-supplied pre-login session value is not retained after authentication.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-SESS-05 Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery - logout enforcement
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery
tests.expected_result: POST /logout without a valid CSRF token is rejected and does not revoke the session.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-SESS-05 Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery - authenticated mutations
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery
tests.expected_result: Sensitive authenticated POST routes reject missing CSRF tokens and cross-origin request metadata.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-ATHN-06 Testing for Browser Cache Weaknesses - authenticated pages
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Browser Cache Weaknesses; Testing for Logout Functionality
tests.expected_result: Authenticated pages include Cache-Control: no-store.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-SESS lifecycle, timeout, and stale-cookie controls
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Session Management Schema; Testing for Exposed Session Variables; Testing for Logout Functionality; Testing Session Timeout; Testing for Session Puzzling; Testing for Session Hijacking
tests.asvs_section: Session Management; Logout; Secret Hygiene; Logging
tests.expected_result: A real authenticated session can access a protected route, valid logout revokes the server-side session, the old cookie and a synthetic stale cookie cannot reuse protected access, and static evidence covers idle timeout, absolute timeout, concurrent-session policy, exposed-token controls, session puzzling, and revocation race behavior.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-06 Test HTTP Methods - OPTIONS and TRACE
tests.wstg_section: Test HTTP Methods
tests.expected_result: Unsupported methods are rejected and TRACE does not echo request data.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INFO-03 Review Webserver Metafiles for Information Leakage
tests.wstg_section: Review Webserver Metafiles; Identify Application Entry Points
tests.expected_result: Metafiles do not disclose sensitive paths or credentials; security.txt may be absent or safe.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INFO-02 Fingerprint Web Server - unauthenticated disclosure and error handling
tests.wstg_section: Fingerprint Web Server; Testing for Improper Error Handling
tests.expected_result: Unauthenticated pages and errors do not expose stack traces, secrets, private paths, or framework banners.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-ATHZ-01 Testing Directory Traversal File Include - safe endpoint probes
tests.wstg_section: Testing Directory Traversal File Include
tests.expected_result: Dot segments and traversal encodings are rejected or routed to a safe error without sensitive content.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-01 Testing for Reflected Cross Site Scripting - safe parameters
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Reflected Cross Site Scripting
tests.expected_result: Probe strings are not reflected as executable markup on unauthenticated or redirect-gated routes.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-12 Testing for Command Injection - safe OSMAP command-boundary due diligence
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Command Injection
tests.asvs_section: Input Validation; Injection Prevention; Error Handling and Logging
tests.expected_result: Safe shell-shaped, encoded, canary, and bounded timing probes across login, mailbox, message, attachment, search, draft, send, and bulk-move routes remain inert, produce no command output or shell diagnostics, avoid HTTP 500s, and leave services healthy.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-10 Testing for IMAP SMTP Injection - webmail input validation
tests.wstg_section: Testing for IMAP SMTP Injection
tests.asvs_section: Input Validation; Output Encoding; Injection Prevention; Logging; File and Resource Handling
tests.expected_result: Authenticated webmail probes reject SMTP header/newline injection in recipients and subjects, reject display-name-shaped recipients outside the supported addr-spec grammar, reject mailbox/UID/search tampering safely, reject path-like attachment filenames, normalize dangerous attachment content types, keep body text as sendmail stdin, and retain stored HTML sanitization controls.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-03/04 Testing HTTP Verb Tampering and HTTP Parameter Pollution
tests.wstg_section: Testing for HTTP Verb Tampering; Testing for HTTP Parameter Pollution
tests.asvs_section: Input Validation; Access Control; Injection Prevention; Error Handling
tests.expected_result: Unsupported HTTP methods, GET bodies, method mismatches, unsupported form content types, duplicate query parameters, and duplicate form fields are rejected without creating alternate state-changing paths.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-15/16/17 Testing HTTP Host Header and Smuggling Inputs
tests.wstg_section: Testing for HTTP Splitting Smuggling; Testing for HTTP Incoming Requests; Testing for Host Header Injection
tests.asvs_section: Input Validation; Access Control; Injection Prevention; Error Handling
tests.expected_result: Raw HTTP probes for CL.TE smuggling shape, duplicate Content-Length, encoded CRLF targets, missing or malformed Host, folded headers, non-normalized targets, duplicate Host, and untrusted Host input fail closed or avoid host reflection.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-05/06/07/08/09/11/13/14/18/19 Injection Applicability Review
tests.wstg_section: Remaining input-validation injection classes without current OSMAP browser surfaces
tests.asvs_section: Input Validation; Injection Prevention; Error Handling
tests.expected_result: The current OSMAP browser surface has no SQL, LDAP, XML, XPath, SSI, runtime code, format-string, server-side template, or SSRF-capable backend surface; incubated injection coverage is represented by the named Slice 4 lanes.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CLNT-07 Testing Cross Origin Resource Sharing
tests.wstg_section: Testing Cross Origin Resource Sharing
tests.expected_result: Cross-origin probes do not receive permissive credentialed CORS headers.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-INPV-02 Testing for Stored Cross Site Scripting - HTML email rendering policy
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Stored Cross Site Scripting; Testing for DOM-Based Cross Site Scripting
tests.expected_result: Live injected HTML email evidence shows sanitized rendering, unsafe scheme rejection, external fetch blocking, and escaped plaintext fallback.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-BUSL-08 Test Upload of Unexpected File Types - attachment handling policy
tests.wstg_section: Test Upload of Unexpected File Types; Test Upload of Malicious Files
tests.expected_result: Live attachment evidence shows bounded multipart handling and forced-download attachment responses with nosniff and no-store.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-ATHZ authorization account-isolation negative evidence
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Bypassing Authorization Schema; Testing for Privilege Escalation; Testing for Insecure Direct Object References
tests.asvs_section: Access Control; CSRF and Request Integrity; Session Management; Logging
tests.expected_result: A primary authenticated session cannot expose host-injected secondary mailbox, message, attachment, sent-mail, search, stale-session, or route-bypass evidence; static evidence shows draft, send, helper, search, and bulk routes bind authority to the validated session.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-05 Enumerate Infrastructure and Application Admin Interfaces - host bindings
tests.wstg_section: Test Network Infrastructure Configuration; Enumerate Infrastructure and Application Admin Interfaces
tests.expected_result: nginx, OSMAP serve, and helper are running; OSMAP serve binds to loopback only; public HTTPS is the exposed browser path.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-01 Test Network Infrastructure Configuration - pf posture
tests.wstg_section: Test Network Infrastructure Configuration
tests.expected_result: pf is enabled with default drop posture and narrow exposed services.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CONF-02 Test Application Platform Configuration - SBOM and dependency alignment
tests.wstg_section: Test Application Platform Configuration
tests.expected_result: Repo contains lockfile and supply-chain documentation or tooling, and locked Cargo metadata resolves successfully.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-BUSL-04 Test Process Timing - authenticated draft route lifecycle
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Process Timing; Test Upload of Unexpected File Types; Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery; Testing for Insecure Direct Object References
tests.asvs_section: Access Control; CSRF and Request Integrity; Session Management; Logging; File and Resource Handling
tests.expected_result: Authenticated draft save, list, resume, delete, and send-success cleanup work only with valid session, CSRF, and same-origin metadata; stale sessions and attachment-limit probes fail closed; generated evidence is redacted and safe.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-BUSL-08 Test Upload of Unexpected File Types - authenticated selected source attachments
tests.wstg_section: Test Upload of Unexpected File Types; Test Upload of Malicious Files; Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery; Testing for Insecure Direct Object References
tests.asvs_section: Access Control; CSRF and Request Integrity; Session Management; Logging; File and Resource Handling; Browser Security
tests.expected_result: Authenticated reply/forward selected source attachments are re-fetched through the helper and included only with valid session, CSRF, same-origin metadata, mailbox, UID, and part path; duplicate, tampered, stale, and redaction cases fail closed.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-BUSL-04 Test Process Timing - bounded bulk folder actions
tests.wstg_section: Test Process Timing; Testing for Cross Site Request Forgery; Testing for Insecure Direct Object References
tests.asvs_section: Access Control; CSRF and Request Integrity; Session Management; Logging
tests.expected_result: Live selected-message archive evidence shows folder actions are capped, CSRF-bound, budget-bound, limited to approved destinations, revalidated per message, and report partial success explicitly.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CRYP-01/03 TLS and cleartext transport evidence
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Weak Transport Layer Security; Testing for Sensitive Information Sent via Unencrypted Channels
tests.asvs_section: Communications Security and Session Token Transport
tests.expected_result: TLS standard validation passes, HTTPS login is available, HSTS is present, and cleartext HTTP redirects to HTTPS or is unreachable.

tests.test_name: WSTG-v42-CRYP-02/04 Crypto Primitive Applicability Review
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Padding Oracle; Testing for Weak Encryption
tests.asvs_section: Architecture, Authentication, and Error Handling Boundaries
tests.expected_result: Padding-oracle and weak-encryption rows are not applicable because OSMAP has no application encryption/decryption primitive or CBC decrypt route.

tests.test_name: OWASP Top 10 2025 A09 Security Logging and Alerting Failures - audit event and redaction posture
tests.wstg_section: Testing for Improper Error Handling; OSMAP security logging review
tests.asvs_section: Logging, Error Handling, and Sensitive Data Protection
tests.expected_result: Source and docs show structured auth, session, mailbox, request, and release-gate events, and dynamic WSTG evidence redaction finds no passwords, TOTP material, session tokens, CSRF tokens, or message bodies.

gaps.reason: Tests that send real mail, move real messages, or alter durable settings require controlled validation accounts and fixtures. The runner skips these unless explicitly credential-enabled.
The pack validates OSMAP browser boundaries and source controls. Mail-stack content filtering belongs to the mailstack validation tooling and is not broadened here.
This pack validates OSMAP-relevant browser, auth, session, rendering, attachment, host-binding, and deployment controls. It is not a complete ASVS verification program for the full mail platform.
